coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web research used 12 captured grouped search actions, including four week-window French queries, general French/English/Arabic discovery, student, teacher and market labor searches, local/regional reporting, Iconi/opposition leads, a Shikomori keyword query, and official/human-rights searches. Five current-unit pages/issues were opened with five saved read scopes: three news-article bodies, one archive listing and selected portions of one newspaper issue; two have explicit read limitations. The 12 captures preserve 315 result headers. Masiwa’s two student stories share outlet/author; no count verifies 50 for any retained event. Africa-Press coverage remains held; other pages had technical retrieval failures. No LexisNexis-equivalent search or robust Comorian-language archive pass was available. Findings are candidates and gaps, not a claim of exhaustive coverage or absence.
